title: Natural-number reindexing of algebraic tensor Kunneth
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field] and A,B integer cochain complexes of k-vector spaces, in the conventions of [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], whose terms are zero in negative degrees. Write T=Tot(A tensor_k B) with the signed differential of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For every natural n there is a k-linear equivalence from the direct sum over natural p+q=n of H^p(A) tensor_k H^q(B) to H^n(T). For cycles a in A^p and b in B^q it sends [a] tensor [b] to the class of a total cycle z whose inclusion is the (p,q)-summand inclusion of a tensor b.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-kunneth (the Kunneth lemma used in Tag 0BED)

proof.text: Embed the natural pairs (p,q) with p+q=n in the integer pairs by casting both coordinates. Construct the induced direct-sum linear map with DirectSum.toModule and the left inverse with DFinsupp.comapDomain. They compose to the identity on every natural summand, so the inclusion is injective.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-kunneth (the Kunneth lemma used in Tag 0BED)

proof.text: The inclusion is surjective by direct-sum induction. For a nonnegative integer pair use (p.toNat,q.toNat) and cast the summand along the equality of indices. If either coordinate is negative, the corresponding complex term is zero, hence its homology is zero and the tensor summand is zero. This treats every integer summand and therefore their finite sums.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-kunneth (the Kunneth lemma used in Tag 0BED)

proof.text: Apply the integer-index tensor_kunneth with lower bound zero for both complexes. Compose its equivalence with the bijective inclusion constructed in the first two steps. The integer generator formula at the cast pair is exactly the natural-degree generator formula.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_kunneth_nat {k : Type w} [Field k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℤ)
    (hA : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (A.X p))
    (hB : ∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 → IsZero (B.X q)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
      (A.homology (i.val.1 : ℤ)) ⊗[k] (B.homology (i.val.2 : ℤ))) ≃ₗ[k]
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homology
          (n : ℤ),
      ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
        (a : A.cycles (i.val.1 : ℤ)) (b : B.cycles (i.val.2 : ℤ)),
        ∃ z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).cycles (n : ℤ),
          (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).iCycles (n : ℤ) z =
            ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
              (i.val.1 : ℤ) (i.val.2 : ℤ) (n : ℤ) (by
                change (i.val.1 : ℤ) + (i.val.2 : ℤ) = (n : ℤ)
                exact_mod_cast i.property)
              ((A.iCycles (i.val.1 : ℤ) a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles (i.val.2 : ℤ) b)) ∧
          e (DirectSum.lof k _ _ i
              ((A.homologyπ (i.val.1 : ℤ) a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.homologyπ (i.val.2 : ℤ) b))) =
            (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homologyπ (n : ℤ) z
